description: Decide whether the user can lower their contracted power (potencia contratada) and how much they would save per year. Compares the power they pay for against the maximum their meter actually recorded, leaving a safety margin, and works out the payback period against the one-off fee for changing it. This is the single most common way to cut a Spanish electricity bill without changing supplier.

file_path.description: Absolute path to the invoice file on this machine (PDF, PNG, JPG, WEBP). The file is read locally and never uploaded anywhere.

invoice.description: The `invoice` object returned by a previous read_invoice call. Pass this to analyse the same invoice again without re-reading the file, which is much faster.

qr_url.description: An already-decoded CNMC comparator URL (https://comparador.cnmc.gob.es/comparador/QRE?...). Use this when the QR has been read elsewhere.
